agent.commit_message_instructions: Follow Conventional Commits: begin the subject with one of these type prefixes followed by a colon and a space — chore:, docs:, feat:, fix:, refactor:, test:. Use the imperative mood after the prefix (e.g. 'feat: add match expression', not 'feat: added match expression'). Keep the first line under 72 characters with no trailing period. Limit each commit to one logical change. Add a body explaining the why when the change is non-trivial.
